purpose: Validate faction FSM/content shape before opening H2A; not a final balance freeze.
requiredMetrics: ending coverage and ending counts by route/faction
faction TARGETED role incidence by faction
sudden faction ending share versus committed-ladder faction ending share
mean/median years from faction contact to opt-out/close/commitment/ending
illegal faction lifecycle state count (must be zero)
personal faction event after OPTED_OUT/CLOSED count (must be zero)
generic fallback share by age band
combined fallback substitution view without conflating the two

retentionPolicy.note: All skipped experiment harnesses remain available for relevant future changes and the H2B/pre-freeze regression.

h2aDecisionRule: Use only hard correctness blockers from SOLID_STATE_H2A_HUMAN_PLAYTEST_GATE_v0.1.md. Balance misses are warnings, not H2A blockers.
stopCondition: After report generation, stop for design review/H2A decision. Do not auto-tune.
